name: omniget-mcp
description: Desktop toolbox for coding agents: downloads, files, pages, ports, chats and cleanup, in OmniGet
long_description: Gives the assistant OmniGet's desktop toolbox: queue downloads, follow them to the end and read why one failed, drive the built-in browser, convert files, pack a folder into one prompt-ready file, and see what your OmniGet agents are working on. Everything runs in the OmniGet desktop app on your computer: install it from https://getomniget.com, open **Settings → AI & agents → Connect to other apps → More options** and create a connection. Paste its token below. Without the app running, or without a token, every call explains what is missing. Linux builds are x86_64 only.

token.title: Connection token
token.description: From a connection created in OmniGet under Settings → AI & agents → Connect to other apps → More options. Tool calls return TOKEN_MISSING until it is set.

url.title: Local endpoint
url.description: The address shown in OmniGet under Settings → AI & agents.
